package langtest // import "github.com/geoffmilleraz/fathom/pkg/lang/langtest"

Package langtest is the conformance check for a dialect pack (ADR-092, design
§6). A pack author calls CheckPack from a test:

    func TestPack(t *testing.T) {
    	if err := langtest.CheckPack(os.DirFS("pack")); err != nil {
    		t.Fatal(err)
    	}
    }

It runs what lang.New runs (the manifest rules, the cross-dialect rules against
the built-in dialects, query compilation), then holds the pack to its own
goldens and to its required kinds.

A golden is dialects/<id>/testdata/<name>.golden.json beside the file
dialects/<id>/testdata/<name> it describes. It holds the lang.Result of reading
that file, with the path relative to the testdata directory, as Golden prints
it. fathom-lang extract prints the same Result.

FUNCTIONS

func CheckPack(fsys fs.FS) error
    CheckPack holds the pack at fsys to the rules of lang.WithDialects, then to
    its goldens and its required kinds. Every dialect needs at least one golden,
    and every golden must read as it says: the file is read by its own dialect
    and the Result equals the golden. Every required kind of a dialect must
    appear among its goldens' symbols, so a kind the manifest promises is a kind
    a fixture shows. The error lists every failure, or is nil. A pack refused by
    lang.New returns that *lang.PackError alone.

func Golden(res lang.Result) ([]byte, error)
    Golden is the bytes a golden file holds for res.
